title: Scenario and fallback-state lab
description: Inject a perception or compute failure, then choose the fallback policy. The outputs show why a safe response must change the path and maneuver, not merely emit an alert.

policies.label: Continue planned maneuver
policies.detail: Keep the current path while treating the degraded evidence as sufficient.

policies.label: Slow and re-acquire
policies.detail: Reduce maneuver ambition, preserve margin, and seek fresh evidence.

policies.label: Minimal-risk response
policies.detail: Constrain automation and transition to the product-defined minimal-risk behavior.

scenarios.label: Occlusion
scenarios.detail: A large vehicle blocks a crossing area near the planned path.
scenarios.path: Forward path has an unobserved crossing zone
scenarios.maneuver: Continue through the partially observed zone
scenarios.evidence: Recent track ends behind the occluder; no current visibility of the crossing zone.

scenarios.label: Glare or weather
scenarios.detail: Sun glare or precipitation reduces usable visual contrast across one or more views.
scenarios.path: Lane edge and road boundary hypotheses disagree
scenarios.maneuver: Maintain speed with uncertain lane boundary
scenarios.evidence: Exposure and contrast health flags rise; temporal agreement falls.

scenarios.label: Cut-in
scenarios.detail: A nearby vehicle has a plausible path into the current lane.
scenarios.maneuver: Hold speed and retain original following gap
scenarios.evidence: Actor track has lateral velocity and overlapping predicted occupancy.

scenarios.label: Lane ambiguity
scenarios.detail: Markings, construction, or merges leave multiple lane hypotheses plausible.
scenarios.path: Two lane corridors overlap near a merge
scenarios.maneuver: Initiate a lane change across ambiguous boundary
scenarios.evidence: Lane hypotheses disagree across successive observations.

scenarios.label: Stale temporal state
scenarios.detail: The temporal scene estimate has not incorporated a new observation within its allowed age.
scenarios.path: Current plan depends on expired actor motion
scenarios.evidence: Scene timestamp exceeds its age contract; model continuity is historical only.

scenarios.label: Compute degradation
scenarios.detail: The model or scheduling path exceeds the timing budget and new plans arrive late.
scenarios.path: Next trajectory misses its planned refresh point
scenarios.evidence: End-to-end deadline misses rise and reserved compute headroom is exhausted.
